==Problem==
The ten-letter code <math>\text{BEST OF LUCK}</math> represents the ten digits <math>0-9</math>, in order. What 4-digit number is represented by the code word <math>\text{CLUE}</math>?

<math>\textbf{(A)}\ 8671 \qquad
\textbf{(B)}\ 8672 \qquad
\textbf{(C)}\ 9781 \qquad
\textbf{(D)}\ 9782 \qquad
\textbf{(E)}\ 9872</math>

==Solution==
We can derive that <imath>C=8</imath>, <imath>L=6</imath>, <imath>U=7</imath>, and <imath>E=1</imath>. Therefore, the answer is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(A)}\ 8671}</imath>
~edited by OwenTang

==Solution 2==
We can easily see that <math>C=8</math>, which makes only <math>(A)</math> <math>8761</math> and <math>(B)</math> <math>8762</math> possible. Since the only difference between answer choices <math>A</math> and <math>B</math> is the last digit and that the last digit in the code word "CLUE" is <math>E</math>, we can just find that <math>E=1</math> and that the answer is <math>\boxed{\textbf{(A)}\ 8671}</math>. ~solution by SuperVince1
